A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

If you hate vibe coding, it’s because you’re still trying to do the old job. AI does what you ask and won’t push back on requirements that slows your app or delete tables you created for testing. Be an architect instead of developer.
